# M4 calibration and certified thresholds (generated by scripts/m4_summary.py)

392 experiments (r=13 held out). Calibrators and threshold grid fitted on Train (20,000 shots), thresholds selected on Calibrate (15,000), everything below measured on Test (15,000). delta = 0.05. Per-experiment rows: `results/m4_calibration.csv`, `results/m4_guarantees.csv`.

## Calibration on Test (MWPM gap)

## Abort thresholds on Test (MWPM gap, RL prior, all distances and round counts)

Selected = the rule found a threshold (for Learn-then-Test: certified). Exceeds = Test error among kept shots is above alpha. Significant = the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound on the Test error is above alpha, so the excess is not Test-sample noise. Rates are over experiments with a selection.
